senses.en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown
not present where something should be

ex.en: We found the missing kitten asleep behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们发现那只找不到的小猫正在沙发后面睡觉。

ex.en: Missing data can undermine the reliability of research findings and lead policymakers to draw inaccurate conclusions.
ex.zh: 数据缺失会削弱研究结果的可靠性，并导致政策制定者得出不准确的结论。

tip: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。

senses.en: Located on the left side.

ex.en: Keep your ticket in the left-hand pocket of your jacket.
ex.zh: 把票放在夹克左侧的口袋里。

ex.en: Separating cyclists from vehicles in the left-hand lane could make this busy road safer for everyone.
ex.zh: 将骑行者与左侧车道的车辆隔开，可以让这条繁忙道路对所有人都更安全。

tip: left-hand指左侧；left-handed指惯用左手的。

senses.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.
To put something in your pocket, or take money dishonestly.
Small enough to fit easily inside a pocket.

ex.en: I found my missing key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我在外套口袋里找到了丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Pocket dictionaries remain useful for language learners when internet access is unavailable or unreliable.
ex.zh: 当无法上网或网络不稳定时，袖珍词典对语言学习者仍然很有用。

col: out of pocket｜自掏腰包的；亏钱的
tip: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: having many clouds in the sky
not clear or transparent

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
ex.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

ex.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
ex.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

tip: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

senses.en: including everything, or complete in degree
the amount obtained by adding everything together
to reach a particular amount or add amounts together

ex.en: The total cost includes breakfast and a bus ticket.
ex.zh: 总费用包含早餐和一张公交车票。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce total energy consumption while making housing more comfortable throughout the year.
ex.zh: 改善住宅隔热性能可以减少能源总消耗，同时让住房全年都更加舒适。

tip: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.
Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex.en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
ex.zh: 把你的重要文件放在这个防水文件夹里。

ex.en: Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民作出明智的健康决策起着重要作用。

col: important to someone｜对某人很重要
tip: 用It is important to do；importance是名词形式。

senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.
A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
ex.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。

ex.en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

col: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席
tip: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: Let the soup cool, then remove the fat.
ex.zh: 让汤凉下来，再撇去油脂。

ex.en: Although the body needs some fat, excessive consumption can increase the risk of certain health problems.
ex.zh: 虽然人体需要一定的脂肪，但摄入过多会增加某些健康问题的风险。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group.
An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.

ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
ex.zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。

ex.en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

col: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

senses.en: to become healthy and strong through exercise

ex.en: She runs every day to get fit.
ex.zh: 她每天跑步来健身。

ex.en: Joining a sports club can help you get fit.
ex.zh: 加入体育俱乐部可以帮助你保持健康。

tip: get fit 表示“变得健康强壮”；keep fit 表示“保持健康”。
scene: A woman jogging in a park with headphones on, looking energetic.

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: I bought these boots in the winter sale.
ex.zh: 我在冬季促销时买了这双靴子。

ex.en: The sale of locally produced food can support farmers while reducing emissions associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 销售本地生产的食品既能支持农民，也能减少长途运输带来的排放。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: The activity of moving over snow on skis.

ex.en: We went skiing together during our winter holiday.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，我们一起去滑雪了。

ex.en: Skiing attracts winter tourists to mountain regions, creating seasonal jobs but increasing demand for water.
ex.zh: 滑雪吸引冬季游客前往山区，创造了季节性工作，但也增加了用水需求。

tip: 滑雪用go skiing；滑水需说water skiing。

senses.en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.

ex.en: I forgot my password and couldn't open my account.
ex.zh: 我忘了密码，无法登录账户。

ex.en: Using a different password for each account can reduce the risk of personal information being stolen.
ex.zh: 为每个账户设置不同的密码，可以降低个人信息被盗的风险。

col: a strong password｜安全性高的密码
tip: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

senses.en: used to show surprise or admiration

ex.en: Wow! What a beautiful painting!
ex.zh: 哇！多漂亮的画啊！

ex.en: Wow, that's a great idea!
ex.zh: 哇，那是个好主意！

tip: wow 是表示惊叹的语气词。
scene: A child looking amazed at a colourful painting on an easel.

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

senses.en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.

ex.en: A helicopter landed in the field behind our house.
ex.zh: 一架直升机降落在我们屋后的田野里。

ex.en: A rescue helicopter can reach isolated communities when floods make roads unsafe for emergency vehicles.
ex.zh: 当洪水使道路无法供救援车辆安全通行时，救援直升机可以抵达被困的偏远社区。

tip: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

senses.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg
the enclosed storage space at the back of a car
to start a computer and load its operating system

ex.en: My boots kept my feet dry in the rain.
ex.zh: 我的靴子让双脚在雨中保持干爽。

ex.en: Protective boots are essential for construction workers because they reduce the risk of serious foot injuries.
ex.zh: 防护靴对建筑工人至关重要，因为它们能降低脚部严重受伤的风险。

col: a pair of boots｜一双靴子
boot up a computer｜启动电脑
tip: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。

senses.en: a circular band, especially one worn on a finger
to make a bell sound or cause one to sound
to contact someone by telephone

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

col: give someone a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: 响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell goods
the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods
to promote and offer a product for sale

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们在集市买了新鲜桃子。

ex.en: Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.
ex.zh: 企业越来越多地向希望减轻自身环境影响的消费者推销环保产品。

tip: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。

senses.en: The system or process that keeps a building warm.
The process of making something warmer.

ex.en: We turned the heating on when the evening grew chilly.
ex.zh: 傍晚天凉起来时，我们打开了暖气。

ex.en: Improving home insulation can reduce heating costs and lower the environmental impact of household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 改善住宅保温可以降低供暖费用，并减轻家庭能源消耗对环境的影响。

tip: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: Dark smoke rose from the toast in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里的吐司冒出了黑烟。

ex.en: Smoke from forest fires can reduce air quality in cities hundreds of kilometres away.
ex.zh: 森林火灾产生的烟雾会降低数百公里外城市的空气质量。

tip: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

senses.en: to get out of bed, or to stand up

ex.en: I get up at seven every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上七点起床。

ex.en: He got up from his chair to greet us.
ex.zh: 他从椅子上站起来迎接我们。

tip: get up 是“起床并起身”；wake up 只是“醒来”。
scene: A boy stretching as he climbs out of bed in a sunny bedroom.

senses.en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。

ex.en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
ex.zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。

tip: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

senses.en: a series of events or stages that repeats
to travel by bicycle
a vehicle with two wheels powered by pedalling

ex.en: I usually cycle to the park on sunny mornings.
ex.zh: 晴朗的早晨，我通常骑自行车去公园。

ex.en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
ex.zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。

col: cycle to work｜骑自行车上班
tip: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
after the expected time or towards a period's end
used before mentioning a person who has died

ex.en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。

ex.en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
ex.zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。

tip: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based
money or assets used to start or operate a business
a letter in its large form

ex.en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
ex.zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。

tip: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

senses.en: The length of time someone or something has existed.
A period of history with particular features.
To become older or make someone or something seem older.

ex.en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
ex.zh: 我奶奶七十岁时学会了游泳。

ex.en: As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府需要加大对无障碍住房和社区医疗服务的投入。

col: people of all ages｜各年龄段的人
tip: 表示在几岁时用at the age of，不用in。

senses.en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.
To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.

ex.en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
ex.zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕
be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

senses.en: the room in a house where people relax together

ex.en: We watch TV in the living room every evening.
ex.zh: 我们每天晚上在客厅看电视。

ex.en: The living room has a big sofa and a coffee table.
ex.zh: 客厅里有一张大沙发和一张茶几。

tip: living room 与 sitting room 同义，都是客厅/起居室。
scene: A cosy living room with a sofa, coffee table and a TV.

senses.en: something you hear
to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise
sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
ex.zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
ex.zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

tip: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

senses.en: Let someone use something temporarily, expecting its return.
Give support or add a particular quality to something.

ex.en: Could you lend me your umbrella until tomorrow?
ex.zh: 你能把雨伞借给我用到明天吗？

ex.en: Local banks could lend small businesses money to invest in cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 地方银行可以向小企业贷款，帮助它们投资更清洁的生产方式。

col: lend someone something｜把某物借给某人
tip: lend是借出，borrow是借入；过去式为lent。

senses.en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface
to move downwards suddenly and quickly
an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall

ex.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
ex.zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。

ex.en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。

col: dive into the water｜跃入水中
tip: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

senses.en: No longer alive
No longer working, often because power has run out
Completely or exactly, used for emphasis

ex.en: We removed the dead flowers from the balcony pots.
ex.zh: 我们清除了阳台花盆里枯死的花。

ex.en: Leaving dead trees in forests can support biodiversity by providing habitats for insects and small animals.
ex.zh: 将枯树留在森林中能为昆虫和小动物提供栖息地，从而促进生物多样性。

tip: dead是状态，die是动作，death是名词。

senses.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat
Lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
Avoid a difficult question, responsibility, or situation

ex.en: A duck paddled past us with several tiny ducklings.
ex.zh: 一只鸭子带着几只小鸭从我们身旁游过。

ex.en: Urban parks with healthy ponds provide valuable habitats for ducks and other wildlife throughout the year.
ex.zh: 拥有健康池塘的城市公园全年都能为鸭子和其他野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。

senses.en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically.
To fill something tightly or push something into a space.

ex.en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 请把你的东西从厨房餐桌上拿走。

ex.en: Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.
ex.zh: 消费者经常购买很少使用的东西，造成家庭浪费和不必要的资源消耗。

col: stuff a bag with｜用……塞满袋子
tip: 名词stuff不可数且偏口语；正式写作宜用具体名词。

senses.en: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
ex.zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。

ex.en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

col: mean to do something｜打算做某事
mean doing something｜意味着做某事
be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
ex.zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。

ex.en: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
ex.zh: 负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

senses.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country
a group sharing a national identity, culture, or history

ex.en: The application form asks for my nationality and address.
ex.zh: 申请表要求填写我的国籍和地址。

ex.en: Access to essential healthcare should depend on medical need rather than a person's nationality or income.
ex.zh: 获得基本医疗服务应取决于医疗需求，而非个人国籍或收入。

col: people of different nationalities｜不同国籍的人
tip: nationality指国籍，不等同于出生地或族裔。

senses.en: A straight tool for measuring lengths or drawing straight lines.
A person who governs a country or territory.

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
ex.zh: 用尺子在这里画一条直线。

ex.en: The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.
ex.zh: 古代统治者的决策往往影响贸易、建筑以及普通人的日常生活。

col: measure with a ruler｜用尺子测量
tip: a ruler可指一把尺子或一位统治者，需看语境。

senses.en: A set of steps connecting different levels of a building.

ex.en: We carried the heavy suitcase up the narrow stairs.
ex.zh: 我们把沉重的行李箱沿着狭窄的楼梯搬了上去。

ex.en: Public buildings should provide lifts alongside stairs to ensure equal access for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 公共建筑应在楼梯之外配备电梯，确保行动不便者也能平等使用。

col: a flight of stairs｜一段楼梯
tip: stairs是复数，谓语用复数；一段楼梯用a flight of stairs。

senses.en: Not closed, or available for people to enter and use.
To make something accessible or start operating a business.
Honest about your thoughts, or willing to consider new ideas.

ex.en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
ex.zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
ex.zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。

col: open to the public｜向公众开放
open to suggestions｜愿意听取建议
keep an open mind｜保持开放心态
tip: be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

senses.en: A person who sings, especially as a job.

ex.en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
ex.zh: 观众开始鼓掌时，歌手露出了笑容。

ex.en: Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.
ex.zh: 当地节庆为年轻歌手提供了宝贵的公开演出机会，帮助他们建立对自身能力的信心。

tip: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。

senses.en: a boy or man that a person has a romantic relationship with

ex.en: Her boyfriend lives in another city.
ex.zh: 她的男朋友住在另一个城市。

ex.en: He is my boyfriend, not my brother.
ex.zh: 他是我男朋友，不是我哥哥。

tip: boyfriend/girlfriend 表示恋爱对象，好朋友说 friend。
scene: Two teenagers holding hands and smiling while walking in a park.

senses.en: matching the facts rather than being false or invented
having the essential qualities expected of someone or something
remaining loyal to a person, belief, or principle

ex.en: Is it TRUE that your cat can open doors?
ex.zh: 你的猫会开门，这是真的吗？

ex.en: Students must assess whether online claims are TRUE before using them as evidence in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学生在将网上的说法用作学术论文的论据之前，必须评估其是否属实。

col: true to your word｜信守诺言
tip: true强调符合事实；real强调实际存在。

senses.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.
Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences.
To cover something completely with a layer.

ex.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。

ex.en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
ex.zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。

col: a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪
tip: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

senses.en: to make a machine or light start working

ex.en: Turn on the radio, please.
ex.zh: 请打开收音机。

ex.en: She turned on the computer and began to work.
ex.zh: 她打开电脑开始工作。

tip: turn on 是“打开”；反义 turn off 是“关掉”。
scene: A hand turning on a radio on a kitchen counter.

senses.en: one of the foods used to prepare a dish
one of the things needed to achieve a particular result

ex.en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
ex.zh: 鲜姜是这道汤的主要食材。

ex.en: Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.
ex.zh: 公众信任是成功实施环境政策的必要因素。

tip: 是可数名词；既指烹饪配料，也可比喻必要因素。

senses.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
ex.zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。

ex.en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a piece of candy｜一块糖果
a candy bar｜一条巧克力糖
tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

senses.en: A sheltered area of water where boats can stay safely.
To keep a thought or feeling, often secretly.
To hide or shelter someone, especially someone wanted by authorities.

ex.en: Small fishing boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
ex.zh: 小渔船在日落前回到了港湾。

ex.en: Expanding the harbour could increase trade, but construction may damage nearby coastal habitats.
ex.zh: 扩建港口可能促进贸易，但施工可能破坏附近的沿海栖息地。

tip: 英式拼写harbour，美式拼写harbor。

senses.en: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex.en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
ex.zh: 坐了一上午后，我感觉背部僵硬。

ex.en: Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 当地居民很可能支持能缓解拥堵并方便就业出行的交通项目。

col: at the back of｜在…的后部
tip: go back表示回去；back作动词可表示支持。

senses.en: An account giving an opinion of a book, product, or performance.
A careful examination to assess something or consider changes.
To examine, study again, or give an opinion about something.

ex.en: Her review convinced me to read the whole novel.
ex.zh: 她的书评让我决定读完整部小说。

ex.en: Governments should regularly review housing policies to ensure that affordable accommodation remains available to low-income families.
ex.zh: 政府应定期审查住房政策，确保低收入家庭仍能获得负担得起的住所。

tip: 复习在美式英语中常用review，英式常用revise。

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

ex.en: We stayed awake until midnight watching the snow fall.
ex.zh: 我们一直醒着看雪，直到午夜。

ex.en: Extending public transport services beyond midnight would benefit shift workers who currently rely on expensive taxi journeys.
ex.zh: 将公共交通服务延长至午夜之后，将有利于目前依赖昂贵出租车出行的轮班工作者。

tip: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。

senses.en: the main dish of a meal

ex.en: The main course was chicken with rice.
ex.zh: 主菜是鸡肉配米饭。

ex.en: What would you like for your main course?
ex.zh: 你的主菜想吃什么？

tip: 西餐顺序：starter（前菜）→ main course（主菜）→ dessert（甜点）。
scene: A plate of grilled chicken with rice and vegetables served on a table.

senses.en: To go back, or give something back.
The act of coming or going back.
Money or benefits gained from an investment or activity.

ex.en: Please return these library books before you go away.
ex.zh: 请在离开之前归还这些图书馆的书。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can generate a substantial economic return by improving future employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以通过改善未来就业机会，带来可观的经济回报。

col: return to work｜重返工作岗位
tip: return已含“回”的意思，通常不再加back。

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。

ex.en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。

tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

senses.en: a person who runs, especially for exercise or in races

ex.en: A runner in bright shoes passed us by the lake.
ex.zh: 一位穿着亮色鞋子的跑步者在湖边从我们身旁跑过。

ex.en: Urban parks provide runners with safer exercise spaces away from heavy traffic and polluted main roads.
ex.zh: 城市公园为跑步者提供更安全的锻炼空间，远离繁忙交通和污染严重的主干道。

tip: run加-er时双写n；runner-up指亚军。

senses.en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing
a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel

ex.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
ex.zh: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。

ex.en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
ex.zh: 定期牙科检查有助于预防蛀牙，减少接受昂贵治疗的需要。

tip: 复数是不规则形式teeth，注意元音也变化。

senses.en: An unexpected event, or the feeling it causes.
To make someone feel amazed by something unexpected.

ex.en: Finding a birthday cake in the kitchen was a lovely surprise.
ex.zh: 在厨房里发现一个生日蛋糕，真是个美好的惊喜。

ex.en: The survey results may surprise policymakers who assume that young people prefer online learning.
ex.zh: 调查结果可能让那些认为年轻人偏爱线上学习的政策制定者感到意外。

col: to someone's surprise｜令某人惊讶的是
take someone by surprise｜使某人措手不及
tip: 人感到惊讶用surprised；事物令人惊讶用surprising。

senses.en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness.
A container that holds or protects something.
A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。

ex.en: In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.
ex.zh: 在许多情况下，投资预防保健比在疾病出现后进行治疗更具成本效益。

col: in some cases｜在某些情况下
in case of emergency｜遇到紧急情况时
a strong case for｜支持某事的有力论据
tip: in case后接从句；in case of后接名词。

senses.en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs

ex.en: A tiny spider built a web beside our window.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛在我们窗边结了网。

ex.en: Although many people fear spiders, these creatures help control insect populations in gardens and agricultural environments.
ex.zh: 虽然许多人害怕蜘蛛，但它们有助于控制花园和农业环境中的昆虫数量。

tip: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。

senses.en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.

ex.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
ex.zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
ex.zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

tip: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

senses.en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature.
Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.

ex.en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
ex.zh: 一群骑行者在村里的面包店外停了下来。

ex.en: Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 教师可以根据学生的学习需求分组，以便在课堂活动中提供更有效的支持。

tip: a group of后常接复数名词；动词常用group A by B。

senses.en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour.
A hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or hot.
To cover or fill something with many small things.

ex.en: Could you pass me the pepper for my soup?
ex.zh: 能把胡椒粉递给我，让我加到汤里吗？

ex.en: Farmers can grow peppers in greenhouses to maintain a reliable food supply throughout the year.
ex.zh: 农民可以在温室里种植甜椒，以维持全年的稳定食物供应。

col: pepper something with examples｜在某事物中加入大量例子
tip: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。

senses.en: to let someone do something
to make something possible
to provide enough time or resources for something

ex.en: The library allows visitors to borrow five books at once.
ex.zh: 图书馆允许访客一次借五本书。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to balance their professional responsibilities with family commitments more effectively.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排使员工能够更有效地兼顾工作职责与家庭义务。

col: allow someone to do something｜允许某人做某事
allow enough time｜留出足够时间
allow for delays｜考虑到可能的延误
tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

senses.en: staying outdoors in a tent, usually for a holiday

ex.en: We are going camping by the river this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末我们要去河边露营。

ex.en: Camping can encourage greater appreciation of nature, provided visitors avoid disturbing wildlife and take their rubbish home.
ex.zh: 露营能增进人们对自然的欣赏，前提是游客不打扰野生动物，并把垃圾带走。

tip: 活动名词camping不可数；去露营说go camping。

senses.en: a place where buses start and end their journeys

ex.en: The coach leaves from the bus station at ten.
ex.zh: 长途汽车十点从汽车站出发。

ex.en: There is a café next to the bus station.
ex.zh: 汽车站旁边有一家咖啡馆。

tip: bus station 是公交车始发/终点站；bus stop 是沿途的小站牌。
scene: A large coach parked at a bus station with passengers waiting by their bags.

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group or organisation

ex.en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
ex.zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。

ex.en: Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.
ex.zh: 社区中的每一位成员都可以通过定期参与志愿服务，为保护当地绿地出力。

tip: 表示某团体的成员，用a member of。

senses.en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh
to try to catch fish

ex.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
ex.zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。

ex.en: Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.
ex.zh: 只要捕捞方式能保护海洋生态系统，食用本地捕获的鱼就能支持沿海社区。

tip: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

senses.en: Someone's female child.

ex.en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他们的女儿给全家人做了薄煎饼。

ex.en: Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.
ex.zh: 平等的受教育机会确保女儿和儿子都能有相近的机会发展自身才能。

col: a teenage daughter｜十几岁的女儿
a mother and daughter｜一对母女
tip: daughter-in-law是儿媳，不是继女。

senses.en: during the time that; but

ex.en: She listened to music while she did her homework.
ex.zh: 她做作业时听音乐。

ex.en: He likes tea while his sister likes coffee.
ex.zh: 他喜欢茶，而他妹妹喜欢咖啡。

tip: while 引导时间状语从句“当…时”；也表示对比“然而”。
scene: A girl doing homework at a desk with headphones on.

senses.en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk

ex.en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
ex.zh: 几只绵羊正在农场附近的一棵树下休息。

ex.en: Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 在脆弱的草地上饲养过多绵羊会破坏植被，增加水土流失的风险。

col: a flock of sheep｜一群绵羊
tip: sheep单复数同形；山羊是goat。

senses.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles.
A group of fish swimming together.

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
ex.zh: 我们一起沿着河边步行上学。

ex.en: Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 每所学校都应提供机会，让学生在学习学科知识的同时培养实践技能。

tip: go to school指上学；go to the school指去校址。

senses.en: a place where someone can live or stay
an arrangement that meets different needs or settles a disagreement

ex.en: We found cheap accommodation near the beach last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们在海滩附近找到了便宜的住处。

ex.en: Universities should provide affordable accommodation so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds can study without excessive financial pressure.
ex.zh: 大学应提供价格可负担的住宿，让家境困难的学生能够在不过度承受经济压力的情况下学习。

tip: 英式英语中表住宿通常不可数；注意双c、双m。

senses.en: Put something somewhere, or establish a condition, value, or rule.
A group of related things that belong together.
Fixed or arranged in advance.

ex.en: She set the bowl gently on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 她把碗轻轻放在厨房的桌子上。

ex.en: Governments should set clear targets for reducing air pollution and regularly assess progress towards achieving them.
ex.zh: 政府应设定明确的空气污染减排目标，并定期评估实现这些目标的进展。

col: a set of tools｜一套工具
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为set；现在分词为setting。

senses.en: a large animal that lives in African rivers

ex.en: The hippo was swimming in the river.
ex.zh: 河马在河里游泳。

ex.en: We saw a hippo at the zoo on Sunday.
ex.zh: 周日我们在动物园看到了一只河马。

tip: hippo 是 hippopotamus 的简称，复数 hippos。
scene: A large grey hippo half-submerged in a river, only its head showing.

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: On most occasions, but not always.

ex.en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.
ex.zh: 有朋友和家人的支持，人们通常更容易保持健康的习惯。

col: as usually happens｜正如通常发生的那样
tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: Past events, or the study of them.
A record of someone's or something's past experiences or conditions.

ex.en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
ex.zh: 导游讲述了这座古堡的历史。

ex.en: Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.
ex.zh: 学习历史有助于公民理解过去的决策如何持续塑造现代社会及其制度。

tip: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。

senses.en: a performer who wears funny clothes and makes people laugh
someone who behaves foolishly to make others laugh
to behave playfully or foolishly to amuse others

ex.en: The clown made a tiny dog from a balloon.
ex.zh: 小丑用一个气球做出了一只小狗。

ex.en: A trained clown can help young patients feel more comfortable during their stay in hospital.
ex.zh: 受过训练的小丑演员能帮助住院儿童放松心情。

tip: clown around意为耍宝；称人clown也可能带贬义。

senses.en: Not including a particular person or thing.
Used to introduce a fact limiting what was just said.

ex.en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
ex.zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。

ex.en: The proposed transport policy benefits most residents, except those living in remote rural communities.
ex.zh: 拟议的交通政策惠及大多数居民，但偏远农村社区的居民除外。

tip: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

senses.en: the speaker and other people

ex.en: We are going on holiday next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周去度假。

ex.en: We have English class on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们周一的英语课。

tip: we 是主格“我们”；宾格 us。
scene: Two children with backpacks walking towards a school gate.

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: the building where police officers work

ex.en: The police station is near the town hall.
ex.zh: 警察局在市政厅附近。

ex.en: He went to the police station to report the theft.
ex.zh: 他去警察局报案失窃。

tip: police station 是警察办公的建筑；报案说 report 或 report a crime。
scene: A police station building with a blue sign and police car outside.

senses.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.
Clean, cool, and pleasant, especially when describing air.
New or different from what existed or was used before.

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们通常星期五在家一起做晚饭。

ex.en: Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 允许员工星期五居家办公，可能减轻通勤压力并提高工作满意度。

tip: 首字母大写；on Friday，但 next Friday 前不加 on。

senses.en: To clean something using water, often with soap.
To carry or move something through flowing water.
An act of cleaning with water.

ex.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
ex.zh: 帮忙准备晚餐前，请先洗手。

ex.en: Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子正确洗手，以减少传染病的传播。

col: give something a wash｜把某物洗一洗
tip: wash强调用水洗；clean泛指清洁，不一定用水。

senses.en: A team sport involving carrying, passing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
ex.zh: 我哥哥每周六都和朋友们打英式橄榄球。

ex.en: Schools offering rugby should provide suitable coaching and safety equipment to reduce the risk of injuries.
ex.zh: 开设英式橄榄球课程的学校应提供适当的指导和安全装备，以降低受伤风险。

tip: 通常指英式橄榄球，不等于美式橄榄球。

senses.en: A soft seat with a back for several people

ex.en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

ex.en: A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.
ex.zh: 公共休息室里一张舒适的沙发可以鼓励住户多聚在一起。

col: sit on the sofa｜坐在沙发上
tip: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

senses.en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.

ex.en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。

ex.en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
ex.zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。

col: an interesting finding｜值得关注的发现
find something interesting｜觉得某事有趣
tip: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

senses.en: A cereal plant whose grains are cooked and eaten.

ex.en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们晚餐吃了米饭和清蒸鱼。

ex.en: Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.
ex.zh: 改进灌溉方式可帮助受干旱影响地区的农民在减少用水的同时种植水稻。

col: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip: rice通常不可数；一粒米用a grain of rice。

senses.en: A particular part of a place or geographical region
The amount of surface that something covers
A particular subject or part of an activity

ex.en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
ex.zh: 湖边有一处安静的野餐区。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。

col: an area of research｜研究领域
tip: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。

senses.en: To become better or make something better.

ex.en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
ex.zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。

ex.en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。

col: improve access to｜改善获取……的机会
improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

senses.en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things
the group of senior ministers who make major government decisions

ex.en: The clean cups are in the cabinet above the sink.
ex.zh: 干净杯子放在水槽上方的橱柜里。

ex.en: The cabinet approved a national programme to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 内阁批准了一项全国性计划，以增加快速发展城市中可负担住房的供应。

tip: 可指家具或内阁；内阁由政府高级部长组成。

senses.en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
Producing little or no pollution.

ex.en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
ex.zh: 你旁边的架子上有干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
ex.zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。

tip: clean是干净；clear是清澈或清楚，不能随意互换。

senses.en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services.
An organisation that sells goods or services.
Matters that someone needs to deal with or is responsible for.

ex.en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。

ex.en: Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.
ex.zh: 小企业通常能为当地创造就业机会，但可能难以与大公司竞争。

col: none of your business｜与你无关
tip: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。
